verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents a broad REST API, published as an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, covering resources such as contacts and subscription billing. The same REST API also backs its MCP server and CLI, which points to substantial programmatic coverage. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, and UI capabilities such as tax submission, hour tracking and payment pages are not shown to be exposed via the API. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, evidence that UI-only features (tax filing, time tracking, payment pages, settings) are available through the API, and independent corroboration of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Moneybird API allows you to interact with a Moneybird account in a RESTful manner.
Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
Use the following endpoints to get information about contacts, create new contacts or update existing contacts.
